parameters.query:
SELECT
  (SELECT count(*) FROM projects WHERE status='new') AS new,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM projects WHERE status='qualified') AS qualified,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM projects WHERE status='enriched') AS enriched,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM projects WHERE status='drafted') AS drafted,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM projects WHERE status='rejected') AS rejected,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM messages WHERE status='sent') AS emails_sent,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM messages WHERE status='draft') AS drafts_pending,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM replies WHERE classification='interested') AS interested,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM replies WHERE classification='question') AS questions,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM crm_log) AS crm_contacts,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM suppressions) AS suppressed;
